title: Transitive Closure of a Directed Graph
problemStatement: Given a directed graph with N vertices, determine whether every vertex is reachable from every other vertex. Output the complete reachability matrix.
input: • First line contains integers N and M. • Next M lines contain directed edges.
output: Print an N × N matrix where the value at row i and column j is 1 if vertex j is reachable from i, otherwise 0.
